en: A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a large decorative stone archway forming the entrance to a passage between buildings. The arch is richly ornamented with sculpted figures, motifs of horse heads along the curve, and round medallions with animal reliefs. Above the archway the number "16–22" is inscribed. People are visible walking through the passage behind the arch. Printed captions identify the location as "Hippodromen" and the city as Malmö, with handwritten message text along the right side.
